bullets.text: Ofcom's 5G Spectrum Auction - Ofcom to auction 5.4 GHz of mmWave spectrum, the largest release in UK history.
6G's Undefined Future - Analysts question the economic viability and definition of **6G** as the industry looks ahead.
Neighborhood AI Factories Rise - Telco central offices are transforming into AI hubs, enhancing local computing capabilities.
Newcastle's Free Wi-Fi Initiative - Newcastle teams up with **Purple** to expand free Wi-Fi access across the city.
EE's 5G Speed Solution - **EE** deploys Advanced RAN Coordination to enhance 5G speeds in crowded areas.
Unabiz Restructures Sigfox - Unabiz secures six months to restructure its French **IoT** business amid financial difficulties.
Verizon's Data Fine Upheld - Court rejects **Verizon**'s appeal against a $46.9 million fine for illegal data sharing.
AI Drives Telco Transformation - **AI** is crucial for telcos seeking operational efficiency and automation in a competitive market.
Starlink's Spectrum Acquisition - **SpaceX** buys spectrum to enhance its Direct to Cell mobile service capabilities.
